title: Weekender — Old money / four-color women
summary: The exact selected old-money ad, with one change: its opening grid shows four different women carrying the Weekender. Cognac top-left, Army Green top-right, Dark Chocolate bottom-left, Black bottom-right. Fashion aspiration leads through four distinct outfits and natural settings. Original narration, cream-blouse presenter, caption style, body scenes and 51.3-second edit are preserved.

beats.script:
Everyone wants that old money look until the bag costs more than the trip.

But you don't need a designer label to pull it off. This one gives you that classic, polished feel, whether you're dressing for a weekend away or just heading out for the day.
